messages.content: Who are in the cricket matches scheduled for today?

function.name: sports_analyzer_get_schedule
function.description: Retrieve the schedule of cricket matches for a specific date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

date.description: The date for which to get the schedule of matches.

sport.description: The type of sport. Default is cricket.

country.description: The country for which to get the schedule. If not provided, all countries will be included. Default: 'USA'

The function sports_analyzer_get_schedule expects date, sport (default cricket), country optional default USA. The user didn't specify country, so we can use default USA or maybe we should ask for clarification. The function signature says country optional default USA. But if we want all countries, we might need to pass country: ""? The description: "If not provided, all countries will be included. Default: 'USA'". That seems contradictory: default is USA but if not provided, all countries will be included. Probably default is USA but if omitted, all countries. So we can omit country.
